label: Guda
note: From Tusheti; the name means cheese from a bag; the skin is a young sheep hide with the wool shaved off

about.text: A sheep-milk cheese from Tusheti in Georgia, salted in layers and ripened in a sheepskin bag; the name means cheese from a bag.

steps.note: Covered in felt to keep the milk warm.
Packed in a wineskin with salt between layers, air pressed out.
